title: 第七章 那些古老的事情
content_zh:
当紧握长剑冲向那狰狞诡异的魔物时，高文心中没有了紧张，没有了犹豫，也没有了恐惧，非要说有点什么的话，那恐怕只是一点点的恍惚和不真实感。
他还清晰地记着自己飞机失事的那个瞬间。
他还清晰地记着悬挂在这个世界高空的那十几万年。
他还没有很好地适应高文·塞西尔这个从天而降的身份。
然而就在这一刻，他却握紧了一把古老的家族长剑，猛扑向一头不知道是恶魔还是亡灵的诡异怪物。
巨大的冲击从剑刃上传来，脑海中所有的杂念瞬间烟消云散。
以近乎本能的反应躲过那怪物横扫的利爪，高文顺势将上半身扭转了小半圈，荡开的剑刃在空气中划过一道流光，狠狠地劈砍向怪物一侧的肩膀，而在剑刃下劈的同时，他努力调动着蕴藏在这具躯体中的力量，并将那股力量引导至手中的长剑上。
剑刃根部那一缕微弱的红色在力量的刺激下绽放出璀璨的红光，并仿佛火焰一般沿着剑刃迅猛蔓延，在灼热高温的炙烤下，就连周围的空气都跟着扭曲起来。
那三米高的怪物从剑刃高温中感受到了威胁，以完全不符合其庞大体型的敏捷猛然一个后仰，结果高文的一记劈砍就这么差之毫厘地落空了。
第一次以自己的手释放出这种仿佛魔法般的超自然力量，高文心中难免会有一瞬间的激动和兴奋，大概正是这瞬间的兴奋之情让他没能把握好第一次攻击的节奏，不过很快他便调整了心态，重新将力量灌注在长剑上。
记忆中那些来自高文·塞西尔的技能知识果然都是可以调用的，这副身体也还没衰退到完全发挥不出力量的程度，虽然不知道可以发挥出几成实力，但高文此刻已经平添了大量的信心。
他开始沉浸在战斗中，并努力以最快的速度将脑海中那些不属于自己的战斗经验转化成自己可用的力量。
而在另一边，拜伦却已经陷入苦战。
这位中阶骑士算是塞西尔领数一数二的高手，在为塞西尔家族效忠之前的战斗生涯也让他积累了非凡的战斗经验，然而他在之前怪物进攻城堡的时候便已经消耗了太多的气力，再加上被怪物的诡异魔力侵蚀，体内的暗伤进一步降低了他的战斗力，这让骑士十成的战斗力也只能发挥出四五成而已。
此刻面对怪物的连番猛攻，他只能紧握长剑努力维持不败，一边尽可能节约体力，一边努力寻找着对手的破绽。
瑞贝卡聚集起魔力，一个头颅大小的灼热火球从法杖前端飞出，与远处那只施法怪物的暗影箭在空中激烈碰撞，爆发出惊天动地的爆炸声，随后她喘了口气，并立刻注意到拜伦那边的危险局面，顿时大声对身旁的领地士兵喊道：“你们三个，去帮帮拜伦！”
一名士兵犹豫了一下：“但是领主大人……”
瑞贝卡一边凝聚新的火球术一边叫道：“我们这边暂时没事——但如果拜伦倒下就完了！我以领主的身份命令你们去！”
三名士兵只能领命，与拜伦骑士一同对抗那只可怕的怪物。
高文渐渐沉浸在战斗中，脑海中不属于自己的记忆和经验正在飞快地转化成自己的东西，并提高着他对自己这幅新身体的掌控能力，这个过程给他带来了十足的成就感，等到他从这种沉浸状态稍稍醒来的时候，他发现眼前的怪物已经被自己压着打了。

那涌动着“污泥”的畸变躯体也不是刀枪不入的，被砍了照样会受伤，砍的多了照样会死掉，尽管它们力大无穷又有着体型优势，但只要掌握对抗的方法，人类之躯照样能消灭它们。
这是七百年前留下的经验。
怪物的利爪从头顶掠过，高文一矮身，反手将长剑刺入对手的大腿，后者终于发出一声浑浊的吼叫，身体也不受控制地朝着一旁歪倒，而趁着这个机会，高文对拜伦大声喊道：“尽量攻击它们腹部和下肢，别管胸口，这些家伙没有心脏！”
随后他趁着自己的对手失去平衡，扭身绕到了对方的侧后方，扬起长剑刺向那怪物的后腰：“除了腹腔，它们的另一个弱点在后面！后腰！”
听着来自塞西尔家族先祖的指点，拜伦顿时精神一振，在三名士兵的配合下，他迅速地牵制住了那怪物的行动，并以拼着肩甲被利爪贯穿的代价，直接从对方的胯下钻过，反身一剑命中要害。
而在拜伦解决敌人的前一秒，高文眼前的怪物也沉重地倒了下去。
解决掉敌人之后，高文立刻抬起头，看向远处那个正在用暗影箭和瑞贝卡的火球对轰的怪物，但就在他刚要冲过去刚正面的瞬间，那怪物却突然发出一声凄厉的吼叫，随后浑身痉挛地倒了下去。
琥珀的身影出现在怪物身后，两手各转着一把淬了毒的精钢匕首：“我擅长啊。”
瑞贝卡放下法杖，脸颊因为连续施法而微微有些泛红，她喘了两口气以平复气息，随后严肃地纠正道：“祖先大人说的是后腰，。”
琥珀将手中匕首飞快地旋转了两圈，那匕首便不知道被她藏到了哪里，她跨过怪物的尸体，一边走过来一边撇撇嘴：“切，一点幽默感都没有。”
那些怪物死掉之后便开始飞快地崩解，它们身上不断流淌涌动的泥浆状物质首先停止了流动，随后渐渐干枯、板结，并出现大量细微的裂纹，而随着这些异变“血肉”的腐化脱落，它们将以极快的速度变成一副巨大的、扭曲的血色骸骨。
高文站在被自己击杀的那只怪物旁边，低头看着这个过程，仿佛自言自语地说道：“原来就是这些东西袭击了塞西尔领么……”
赫蒂好奇地看着他：“先祖，您知道这些怪物的来历？”
高文在之前的战斗中已经展露出了对这些怪物极深的了解，甚至还指点了拜伦该怎么对抗它们，所以这一点自然是瞒不住的，他自己也没想瞒着。
“留在这里可能还会遇到它们，我们先进暗道，暗道里有压制那些怪物的东西，它们轻易不会进去，”高文一边迈步向前走去一边说道，“详细情况我可以在路上跟你们说。”
等钻进那条古老的地底通道并前进了一段路之后，高文才打破沉默：“我当年确实对付过它们——事实上当年我们主要对付的就是那些东西。你们应该知道刚铎帝国的崩溃以及第二次开拓的历史吧？”
“当然知道，”瑞贝卡立刻点点头，这些历史可以说是她作为贵族子女的必修课，“七百多年前，洛伦大陆原本只有一个人类国度，那就是位于大陆中央的刚铎帝国。历史记载它是当时大陆上最强盛的帝国，甚至连大陆南部精灵们所建立的白银帝国都不敢轻易与其为敌，但后来笼罩在这个世界周围的以太海发生动荡，在洛伦大陆引发了一场被称作‘黑暗魔潮’的大灾难，灾难的爆发点就在刚铎帝国腹地——几乎是一夜之间，刚铎帝国的首都和三分之一国土被魔潮吞噬，并被汹涌的元素力量分解……”
“并非一夜之间，事实上这个过程持续了将近一个月——刚铎的宫廷法师们在魔潮面前也不是什么都没做的，”高文打断了一下，随后示意对方继续说下去，“不过从结果来看也差不多，你继续。”
“哦……哦，”瑞贝卡脸红了一下，就像被家长检查作业一样更加谨慎地说道，“在那之后，刚铎帝国腹地的魔潮继续向着四周蔓延，并最终完全摧毁了整个国度，这就是刚铎帝国的崩溃。而在那之后，随着以太海的逐渐平静，魔潮的威力开始降低，幸存下来的刚铎遗民便开始了重建文明，由于大陆的中心区已经一片糜烂，不再适宜人类生存，所以他们在一批开拓者的引领下离开了已经变成废墟的帝国，并向着东南西北四个方向进行开拓，史称第二次开拓。祖先大人您就是当年最著名的开拓骑士之一。”
“嗯，历史学的不错，”高文随口夸了一句，“那你应该也听过吧，尽管魔潮结束，刚铎帝国的废墟中却仍然盘踞着大量在魔潮中诞生的怪物，那些怪物就是第二次开拓时人类所面对的最大威胁之一。”

赫蒂睁大了眼睛：“您是说……”
“没错，当年跟我们打的，就是那些东西，”高文叹了口气，“它们从魔潮中诞生，有着仿佛人类一般的轮廓，却绝对不是什么人类。当年刚铎帝国崩溃之后，大量那样的怪物从化为废墟的帝国腹地涌了出来，不断向着四面八方蔓延，追杀着当时的幸存者，所以第二次开拓的前半段与其说是开拓之旅，倒不如说是逃亡之旅。而且即便后来我们脱离了帝国的废土，在大陆边缘建立起新国度，那些怪物也没有消停下来，它们还是不断从帝国废土的方向涌来，频繁冲击文明世界的防线……在安苏立国之后的头十年里，我差不多天天都在跟它们打交道。”
瑞贝卡张大了眼睛，似乎已经被这些古老而传奇的故事深深吸引：“啊，那安苏立国十年之后那些怪物就不再出现了么？”
高文笑了笑，伸手抚摸着少女的头发，露出看傻狍子的笑容：“傻孩子，那之后你祖宗就挂了啊……”
瑞贝卡：“……”
content_en:
When Gawain grasped the sword tightly and rushed towards the ferocious and strange monster, Gawain felt no tension, no hesitation, and no fear in his heart. If anything, it was probably just a little bit of trance and unreality.
He still clearly remembers the moment when his plane crashed.
He still clearly remembered the hundreds of thousands of years that he had been hanging high in the sky of this world.
He has not yet adapted well to the sudden identity of Gawain Cecil.
However, at this moment, he grasped an ancient family sword tightly and pounced towards a strange monster that did not know whether it was a demon or an undead.
A huge impact came from the sword blade, and all the distracting thoughts in his mind disappeared instantly.
Using an almost instinctive reaction to avoid the monster's sweeping claws, Gawain twisted his upper body in a small half circle. The swinging sword blade cut a stream of light in the air and slashed hard at the shoulder of the monster. While slashing under the blade, he worked hard to mobilize the power contained in this body and guide that power to the long sword in his hand.
The faint wisp of red at the root of the sword bloomed with bright red light under the stimulation of power, and spread rapidly along the blade like a flame. Under the scorching heat, even the surrounding air was distorted.
The three-meter-tall monster felt threatened by the high temperature of the blade, and suddenly leaned back with an agility that was completely incompatible with its huge size. As a result, Gawain's slash missed by just a hair.
It was the first time that he used his own hands to release this magical supernatural power. It was inevitable that there would be a moment of excitement in Gawain's heart. It was probably this moment of excitement that made him unable to grasp the rhythm of the first attack. However, he soon adjusted his mentality and poured power into the sword again.
The skills and knowledge from Gawain Cecil in his memory can indeed be used. This body has not declined to the point where it can no longer exert its strength. Although it is not known how much strength it can exert, Gawain has gained a lot of confidence at this moment.
He began to immerse himself in the battle, and tried to convert the combat experiences in his mind that did not belong to him into usable power as quickly as possible.
On the other side, Byron was already struggling.
This mid-level knight is considered one of the top masters in Cecil's command. His fighting career before serving the Cecil family also allowed him to accumulate extraordinary combat experience. However, he had already consumed too much energy when the monster attacked the castle. In addition, he was eroded by the monster's weird magic power, and the hidden wounds in his body further reduced his combat effectiveness. This allowed the knight to only use 40 to 50% of his 100% combat effectiveness.
At this moment, facing the monster's continuous attacks, he could only hold on to the sword tightly and try to remain undefeated. He tried to save his energy as much as possible while trying to find the opponent's flaws.
Rebecca gathered her magic power, and a head-sized scorching fireball flew out from the front of the staff. It collided fiercely with the shadow arrow of the magic-casting monster in the distance in the air, causing an earth-shattering explosion. Then she took a breath and immediately noticed the dangerous situation on Byron's side. She immediately shouted loudly to the territorial soldiers beside her: "You three, go help Byron!"
A soldier hesitated: "But Lord..."
Rebecca shouted while condensing new fireball skills: "We are okay for the time being - but if Byron falls, it will be over! As a lord, I order you to go!"
The three soldiers had no choice but to take orders and fight with the Byron Knight against the terrifying monster.
Gawain gradually became immersed in the battle, and the memories and experiences in his mind that were not his own were quickly transformed into his own, improving his ability to control his new body. This process gave him a full sense of accomplishment. When he woke up from this immersion, he found that the monster in front of him had been suppressed and beaten by him..
The deformed bodies surging with "sludge" are not invulnerable. If they are chopped, they will still be injured, and if they are chopped too much, they will still die. Although they are extremely powerful and have size advantages, as long as they master the method of confrontation, human bodies can still destroy them.
This is the experience left behind seven hundred years ago.
The monster's sharp claws passed over the head. Gawain ducked and stabbed the long sword into the opponent's thigh with his backhand. The latter finally let out a muddy roar and his body tilted to the side uncontrollably. Taking this opportunity, Gawain shouted to Byron: "Try to attack their abdomen and lower limbs, don't worry about the chest, these guys have no heart!"
Then he took advantage of his opponent's loss of balance, twisted around to the opponent's side and rear, raised his sword and stabbed the monster's lower back: "In addition to the abdominal cavity, their other weak point is at the back! The lower back!"
After listening to the instructions from the ancestor of the Cecil family, Byron suddenly became energetic. With the cooperation of three soldiers, he quickly restrained the monster's actions, and at the cost of having his shoulder armor pierced by sharp claws, he got directly under the opponent's crotch and hit the critical point with his sword.
And a second before Byron solved the enemy, the monster in front of Gawain also fell heavily.
After getting rid of the enemy, Gawain immediately raised his head and looked at the monster in the distance who was using shadow arrows and Rebecca's fireballs to fight. But just when he was about to rush over and confront him, the monster suddenly let out a shrill roar, and then fell down convulsively.
Amber's figure appeared behind the monster, spinning a poisoned steel dagger in each hand: "I'm good at it."
Rebecca put down her staff. Her cheeks were slightly red from the continuous casting of spells. She took two breaths to calm down, and then corrected her seriously: "The ancestors are talking about the lower back."
Amber quickly spun the dagger in her hand twice, and she didn't know where she hid the dagger. She stepped over the monster's body and pouted as she walked over: "Tch, no sense of humor at all."
After those monsters died, they began to disintegrate rapidly. The continuously flowing mud-like material on their bodies first stopped flowing, and then gradually dried up, hardened, and appeared a large number of tiny cracks. As these mutated "flesh" decayed and fell off, they would turn into a huge, twisted blood-colored skeleton at an extremely fast speed.
Gawain stood next to the monster he killed, looking down at the process, as if talking to himself: "So these are the things that attacked Cecil's territory..."
Hetty looked at him curiously: "Ancestor, do you know the origin of these monsters?"
Gawain had shown a deep understanding of these monsters in previous battles, and even gave Byron instructions on how to fight them, so naturally he couldn't hide this, and he didn't want to hide it himself.
"We may encounter them if we stay here. Let's go into the secret passage first. There is something to suppress those monsters in the secret passage. They won't be able to get in easily," Gawain said as he stepped forward. "I can tell you the details on the way."
After getting into the ancient underground passage and advancing for a while, Gawain broke his silence: "I did deal with them back then - in fact, those were the things we mainly dealt with back then. You should know the collapse of the Gondor Empire and the history of the second development, right?"
"Of course I know," Rebecca nodded immediately. This history can be said to be a required course for her as a noble child. "More than seven hundred years ago, there was only one human kingdom in the Loren continent, and that was the Gondor Empire in the center of the continent. Historical records indicate that it was the most powerful empire on the continent at that time. Even the Silver Empire established by the elves in the southern part of the continent did not dare to easily attack it. However, the ether sea surrounding the world was turbulent later, triggering a war known as Gondor in the Loren continent.The catastrophe of the 'Dark Magic Tide', the outbreak point of the disaster was in the hinterland of the Gondor Empire - almost overnight, the capital of the Gondor Empire and one-third of its territory were swallowed up by the demonic tide and decomposed by the surging elemental power..."
"It didn't happen overnight. In fact, this process lasted for nearly a month - the court mages of Gondor didn't do anything in the face of the demonic tide," Gawain interrupted, then motioned for the other party to continue, "But the results are similar, you continue. "
"Oh...oh," Rebecca blushed and said more cautiously, as if being checked by a parent on her homework, "After that, the demonic tide in the hinterland of the Gondor Empire continued to spread to all directions, and eventually completely destroyed the entire country. This was the collapse of the Gondor Empire. After that, as the Aether Sea gradually calmed down, the power of the demonic tide began to decrease, and the surviving Gondor remnants began to rebuild civilization. Since the central area of ​​the continent was eroded and no longer suitable for human survival, they left the empire that had become ruins under the leadership of a group of pioneers, and developed in the four directions of southeast, northwest, and history is called the second development. Ancestor, you are one of the most famous pioneer knights back then. "
"Well, I'm good at studying history," Gawain boasted casually, "Then you should have heard that even though the demon tide is over, the ruins of the Gondor Empire are still filled with a large number of monsters born in the demon tide. Those monsters were one of the biggest threats faced by mankind during the second development. "
Hetty opened her eyes wide: "You mean..."
"That's right, those were the things that fought us back then," Gawain sighed, "They were born from the demonic tide, and they have human-like outlines, but they are definitely not human beings. After the collapse of the Gondor Empire, a large number of such monsters emerged from the ruins of the hinterland of the empire and continued to spread in all directions, hunting down the survivors at that time. Therefore, the first half of the second expansion was not so much a journey of expansion as a journey of escape. And even after we left the empire's wasteland and established a new country on the edge of the continent, those monsters did not stop. They continued to pour in from the direction of the empire's wasteland, frequently attacking the defense lines of the civilized world... In the first ten years after the founding of Ansu, I dealt with them almost every day. "
Rebecca opened her eyes wide and seemed to be deeply attracted by these ancient and legendary stories: "Ah, then ten years after Ansu was founded, those monsters will no longer appear? "
Gawain smiled, reached out to stroke the girl's hair, and smiled like a silly roe deer: "Silly boy, your ancestor will die after that..."
Rebecca: "..."
